verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at https://founder.law/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-readable summary of the firm, so a user can point an agent at it. Publishing llms.txt is a fair question for any web-facing business, and here the file actually exists. Beyond a short excerpt, though, the file's depth and coverage are unverified, and there are no other agent-oriented docs or machine-readable specs (all OpenAPI paths return 404). missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth/coverage (e.g. links to service and pricing pages), additional agent-oriented documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usefulness
